author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to build a professional online store with Shopify in this complete Shopify tutorial for beginners. In this video, you’ll learn how to create a Shopify account, add products, organize collections, customize your storefront, configure payments, set up shipping rates, connect a custom domain, and launch your online business. 

Get started with Shopify - https://shopify.pxf.io/aN2d2b

Shopify is one of the most popular eCommerce platforms in the world, making it easy for anyone to create an online store without coding or technical experience. By the end of this tutorial, you'll have the knowledge you need to confidently start selling online.

What You'll Learn:
• How to create a Shopify store
• Adding products and product images
• Creating collections and categories
• Customizing your Shopify theme
• Setting up navigation menus
• Configuring Shopify Payments
• Setting up shipping and delivery rates
• Understanding Shopify plans and pricing
• Connecting a custom domain
